name: OnPoint Community Credit Union
notes: Researched from public onpointcu.com pages (no sign-in). The header login form uses "Login ID" and "Password" with Enroll / Forgot login ID / Forgot password links. Loans can be paid in Digital Banking from an OnPoint account or from an account at another bank or credit union. Automatic loan payments scheduled in Digital Banking with the Loan Payment option run shortly after midnight on the chosen date. No pay-without-signing-in page was found (guest_pay unsupported, inferred). Skip Pay is offered only during promotions (Skip Payment Promotion tile in Digital Banking, branch or phone); no online payment plan. eStatements: select eStatements in the main menu, accept the Site Terms; 25 months of history, monthly email. Member Services 503.228.7077 / 800.527.3932 (M-F 7-7, Sat 9-3). MFA not documented (family default). Online methods bank only: the Loan Payment Options page (added in review) describes payments from OnPoint checking or a verified external account (routing/account number) only.

pay_online.note: Pay your OnPoint loan in Digital Banking under Payments & Transfers > Loan Payments from your OnPoint checking, or from an account at another bank or credit union once you have added and verified it as an external account.

guest_pay.note: OnPoint loans are paid in Digital Banking after you log in. For help with a payment, call 503.228.7077 or 800.527.3932.

autopay.note: Check Make this a recurring transaction when you make a loan payment and pick your payment date. Automatic loan payments you schedule this way run shortly after midnight on that date.

payment_arrangement.note: OnPoint has no online payment plan. During Skip Pay promotions eligible loans show a Skip Payment Promotion tile in Digital Banking; otherwise call 503.228.7077 or 800.527.3932.

help.title: Paying your OnPoint loan
paragraphs: In Digital Banking or the OnPoint Mobile app, select Payments & Transfers from the left menu, then Loan Payments. To make it automatic, check Make this a recurring transaction, pick your payment date and select Make Payment. You can change the amount or cancel a scheduled payment later, and add extra principal payments. To pay an OnPoint credit card, use Account Transfer instead.

To pay from another bank or credit union, choose Payments & Transfers > Add External Account and enter its account number, account type and routing number. After the small trial deposits arrive (two to three business days), verify the account under Payments & Transfers, then set up the payment with Account Transfer.
Questions about a payment? Call 503.228.7077 or 800.527.3932, Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. and Saturday 9 a.m. to 3 p.m., or send a secure message from Messages in Digital Banking.

help.title: When automatic loan payments are made
paragraphs: When automatic loan payments happen depends on how they were set up. If you scheduled them yourself in Digital Banking with the Loan Payment option, each payment runs shortly after midnight on the date you picked.
Payments OnPoint set up for you generally run toward the end of the business day, around 5:45 p.m. If the payment date falls on a weekend or holiday, the payment runs the next business day.

help.title: Skipping a loan payment
paragraphs: OnPoint offers Skip Pay from time to time as a promotion, and members with eligible loans get an email. During a promotion, log in to Digital Banking, find the Skip Payment Promotion tile in the right-hand navigation, and choose the loans and month to skip. The tile does not appear if no loan qualifies.
You can also ask for a Skip Pay at a branch or by calling 503.228.7077 or 800.527.3932.

help.title: eStatements
paragraphs: With eStatements you view statements securely in Digital Banking, get an email each month when one is ready, and keep up to 25 months of history.
To sign up, select eStatements from the main menu, review the Site Terms and select Accept.

help.title: Payment history and past statements
paragraphs: eStatements keep up to 25 months of statement history in Digital Banking. Select eStatements from the main menu to view a past statement.
Payments you make online appear in your payment history; a pending payment shows until it posts.
steps: Open your payment history or statements.
Select a statement to view or download.
